text: Shree Balaji Steel bills freight separately on the last invoice line; the AP team approves it when freight is under ₹5,000 per trip.
On 2 Mar 2026 Priya approved invoice SBST/2526/1184 from Shree Balaji Steel with a ₹3,850 freight line: 'standing agreement allows freight up to ₹5,000 per trip'.
